p: go up hence: The land of Canaan was surrounded by hills: so those who entered it, must go up by the hills.
what to do unto thee: That I may either show mercy if you repent, or else punish your rebellion.
Tabernacle of the congregation: That is, the tabernacle of the congregation: so called because the people turned to it, when they needed to be instructed of the Lord's will.
face to face: Most clearly and familiarly of all others, Nu 12:7,8; De 34:10
name: I care for you and will preserve you in your calling.
presence shall go with thee: Signifying that the Israelites would exceed all other people, through God's favour; Ex 33:16.
glory: Your face, your substance, and your majesty.
goodness pass before thee: My mercy and fatherly care.
proclaim the name of the LORD: See Ex 34:6,7.
mercy on whom I will shew: For finding nothing in man that deserves mercy, he will freely give his.
live: For Moses did not see his face in full majesty, but as man's weakness could bear.
back parts: As much of my glory as in this mortal life you are able to see.
